title: Exercise pulse-pressure reserve does not establish incremental Hungary-to-VA prediction of angiographic coronary disease
abstract: Exercise pulse-pressure reserve did not establish incremental cross-hospital prediction of angiographic coronary disease: frozen Hungary-to-VA log-loss gain -0.01367 nats/patient (95% target bootstrap interval -0.02841 to 0.00149; 138 eligible VA patients), beyond standard noninvasive exercise-test variables. Source cross-validation also showed little gain. This negative diagnostic-prediction result does not contradict reserve-pressure prognostic associations; selection, protocol differences and missingness limit interpretation.
